title: interop A1: Haven-encoded protocol-06 fixtures decoded by mimid
description: Generator crate under crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven/gen/ (not a workspace member) pinned to havenmessenger/interop 2c14e62 writes TLS-PL bytes for each request/response Haven encodes. mimi-protocol test: decode, compare to expected value, re-encode byte-identical. PROVENANCE with repo, commit, SHA-256, license (Apache-2.0). Each mismatch -> bead (mimid bug / Haven divergence / decision+wg). See mimid-1wgh.46.1 design.
notes: 2026-11-02 (worktree agent-a110b5d636f52900b, uncommitted): 19 Haven-encoded fixtures + gen crate (Haven 2c14e62, deterministic, PROVENANCE with SHA-256) under crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven; test haven_fixtures.rs (13 tests pass). 17 fixtures decode, match generator inputs, re-encode byte-identically. 2 Haven divergences, tests assert mimid refuses them: key_material_response_exhausted (partialSuccess with no success client, §5.2 L1283-1284) -> mimid-1wgh.46.1.7; handshake_bundle_commit (GroupInfoOption GroupInfo length-prefixed, §5.3 L1428-1436; rest matches once the 2-byte prefix is removed) -> mimid-1wgh.46.1.8. Spec gap: no userStatus for all-clients-exhausted -> mimid-1wgh.46.1.9 (wg). No mimid bugs found. Not covered: UpdateRoomResponse invalidProposal (Haven encodes ProposalRef list as VLBytes entries; not generated), GroupInfoOption partial, consent cancel/revoke.
